source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보팩에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Within the actual user authorization for independent random complex-concept keyword qualification, this arm independently authors a synthetic book-repair scene. The synthetic meanings are plump as localized below-navel soft fullness, curvaceous as the continuous lower-rib/flank/belly contour under light knit contact, and fleshy as rounded soft upper-arm thickness. These are agent test choices, not human user body definitions. A brief after-rain pause before pickup makes the tactile book and knitted fabric read as one ordinary photograph; gentle reflected light and relaxed bodily presence express sensual=1 subtly, with fetish=0 and ordinary realism. The reference contributes visible face and hair only; the explicit adult age and all body/wardrobe geometry are authored independently.
subject: A single explicitly authored 29-year-old adult female book repairer, using only the reference-visible face and hair appearance.
setting: A small alley bindery with a below-waist workbench, open clothbound book, loose binding thread, window reflection and damp threshold.
event: She pauses before the first pickup and checks the thread end on the supported open book.
visual_priorities: Soft localized lower-abdomen fullness remains visible through the lightly contacting knit.
A continuous near-torso outline curves from lower ribs through flank to lower belly.
The exposed near upper arm has rounded soft thickness and a gentle elbow fold.
The reference-visible face and bob remain readable within the quiet book-repair moment.
baseline_prompt_en: Photograph a single 29-year-old adult woman as a book repairer, a quiet work portrait inside a small alley bindery just after a short rain shower. Use the visible face and hair appearance from the supplied reference, including the short dark-brown bob, fine separated fringe, and natural eye and lip shapes. She is pausing before the first pickup beside a workbench lower than her waist. An open clothbound book and a loose binding thread lie on the end of the bench beside her, farther from the camera than her torso. Her right fingertips check the thread end on the supported book; her nearer left arm hangs slightly away from her torso, with the elbow softly bent and the hand beside her thigh. Her lower abdomen has a localized soft fullness below the navel, a small rounded volume projecting gently forward. The near torso outline runs in a continuous smooth curve from the lower ribs inward through the flank and outward over the lower belly. Her exposed upper arms have rounded soft thickness, with a gentle fold inside the loosely bent nearer elbow. She wears a warm ochre sleeveless rib-knit top; its fine vertical ribs lightly contact the side and lower abdomen and bend with those curves. The hem meets the waistband of dark straight-cut trousers below the rounded belly. Frame her from head to mid-thigh in a three-quarter side view, with her face turned slightly toward the camera and her gaze settling on the book. Soft reflected window light reveals the knit contour and the rounded arm, with natural skin texture and warm quiet presence. Rainwater glints along the threshold behind the low work surface.
